product_family: AdCreative.ai is an AI-powered ad creative platform for generating high-converting ad assets including static creatives, product photography, video ads, and ad copy using proprietary AI models trained on performance data. Targets e-commerce brands, agencies, and small-to-mid-market businesses with tiered subscription plans (Starter, Professional, Ultimate).

privacy.ai_training_note: AdCreative.ai uses anonymized and de-identified user data for the purpose of improving and training its artificial intelligence systems. All personally identifiable information (PII) is stripped before processing. The company explicitly states it does NOT share data with external third parties for AI processing; all AI models are developed and run internally. Does NOT train on personal customer data.

products.name: AdCreative.ai (Core Platform)
products.data_scope: User brand data, ad account credentials (Google/Meta connected via OAuth), campaign performance data, anonymized usage data for AI training
products.notes: Main product with tiered pricing (Starter, Professional, Ultimate). Features include static ad generation, product photography AI, video ad creation, text/copy generation, creative scoring, competitor insights. 4.2M+ users, 1B+ creatives generated.

products.name: Enterprise Offering
products.data_scope: Isolated from standard platform; dedicated instances with custom data handling
products.notes: Available for large organizations requiring dedicated infrastructure and custom security arrangements. Data remains isolated in dedicated instances.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based with tiered plans: Starter ($20/mo annual, $39/mo monthly), Professional ($125/mo annual, $249/mo monthly), Ultimate ($500/mo annual, $999/mo monthly). Credits-based usage model. Free tier available for trial.
compare.data_residency: AWS Ireland (EU); Enterprise instances available for custom deployments

flags: No formal SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications found despite growth-stage maturity and enterprise offering availability. This is typical for marketing/advertising tech but should be noted for regulated industry use cases.
No dedicated trust/security center on website; security and compliance information dispersed across privacy policy and legal notices.
Marketing copy uses term 'Compliance Checker AI' (a product feature for ad compliance, not company compliance); this is NOT a compliance certification.

Legal entity is ADYOUNEED SAS (Paris, France), a wholly-owned subsidiary of publicly listed Appier Group (TSE:4180) since its March 2025 acquisition; the low registered share capital (€1,432.80) is normal for a French SAS and does not indicate a shell entity. Note: any enterprise security certifications held by parent Appier do not automatically transfer to the AdCreative.ai product and were not claimed for it here.
Enterprise security claims (dedicated instances, data isolation) are stated in privacy policy but not independently verified or certified.
